verdict.rationale: A machine-readable API spec is a fair ask for an error-monitoring SaaS, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. A probe of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths on docs.bugsnag.com returned 404 on every one, and the MCP server, CLI and webhook items are not an API spec. Confidence is medium because the spec could live at an unprobed location.
